items.title: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
items.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. The article Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
items.summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
items.summary: Bytedance and several US universities introduce Axion 1.0, an AI agent that rivals top commercial models from OpenAI and Anthropic on benchmarks after just three training phases. The researchers attribute the gains to carefully curated training data rather than ever more training steps. The model, data, and code are freely available. items.title: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
items.summary: OpenAI has significantly strengthened safeguards against extracting internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. In adaptive red-teaming tests, the success rate for extracting protected reasoning fell from 54 percent to 0.2 percent. The company is also suspending thousands to tens of thousands of accounts each week over coordinated distillation campaigns. The article OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 大幅加強了防護措施，防止從 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 中提取內部推理。在自適應紅隊測試中，提取受保護推理的成功率從 54% 下降至 0.2%。該公司還因協同蒸餾活動每週停權數千到數萬個帳戶。

items.title: Nvidia bets at least $500 million on Inception's diffusion models to strengthen its open-source Nemotron lineup
items.summary: Nvidia is close to acquiring AI startup Inception for at least $500 million, according to The Information. The company is just two years old and builds language models based on diffusion processes, an alternative approach to the token-by-token generation used by models like ChatGPT. The deal would bolster Nvidia's own open-source models and its push into robotics. The article Nvidia bets at least $500 million on Inception's diffusion models to strengthen its open-source Nemotron lineup appeared first on The Decoder .
